meta.title: Reunion · chat import and persona
meta.description: Import a DeepSeek history export—or a public share link—into the workspace and distill a portable persona plus relationship memory. Writes companions/<slug>/: SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, transcript.jsonl, meta.json. Local exports stay offline; a chat.deepseek.com/share/… link fetches the public snapshot. No telemetry. Shapes: thread (continue one conversation or share, no persona), merge, separate. Usage: ask to "import my DeepSeek export" or "thread-import this share link" — inspect → import → (digest/compose/commit only for merge) → load. Not multimodal; expired or deleted shares cannot be imported. Uninstalling never deletes companions/.
